summary: Tests should discover resources like interfaces at runtime (example parses nxos show interface brief JSON). Run network integration tests locally with an inventory whose groups match platform names, via ansible-test network-integration.
questions: How do I avoid hard-coding interface names in network tests?
How do I run network integration tests locally?
What should my network test inventory look like?

answer_card.title: Detect resources and run network tests
answer_card.answer_md:
Discover resources at runtime:
```yaml
- cisco.nxos.nxos_command:
    commands: [show interface brief | json]
  register: intout
- set_fact:
    nxos_int1: "{{ intout.stdout_lines[0]['TABLE_interface']['ROW_interface'][1].interface }}"
```
Run locally:
```bash
cd test/integration
cp inventory.network.template inventory.networking   # groups named eos, ios, ...
ansible-test network-integration --inventory ~/myinventory -vvv vyos_facts
```
